title.zh: FCA considers exempting tokenized gold from fund rules to defend London market
title.en: FCA considers exempting tokenized gold from fund rules to defend London market

current_state.zh: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority is weighing an exemption that would allow tokenized gold products to avoid fund regulations, aiming to keep London competitive as a hub for tokenized real-world assets.
